summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Collective Mining Ltd., a Canadian gold/silver exploration company, submitting interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The report contains routine financial results, including a net loss of approximately $20.1 million for Q2 2026, exploration expenses, and balance sheet items. No transaction, strategic review, or special-situation event is described. The exhibits are standard regulatory certifications (Forms 52-109F2) by the CEO and CFO. This is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
